description: Open-source Claude Cowork / Codex / WorkBuddy alternative — a local-first AI office agent that turns one request into real PPTX, DOCX, XLSX and HTML files. Runs DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Claude or Ollama (BYOK), MCP, and can drive Claude Code / Codex CLI. 开源 AI 办公助理，豆包办公 / 千问办公替代。
summary: Local-first AI work agent: turn requests into real files, bring your own LLM, Claude Code or Codex, self-host office automation, and build AI short dramas on an executable canvas.
